en: “Shizuko.”
“Yeah, what's wrong?”
“Do you like stalking people?”
“What the fuh...”
“Why else would you have all these pictures?”
I take out a stack of pictures of the same couple with their child.
There are pictures from every angle, in every sort of location, and you can see their faces super clearly.
“Fifteen years ago something pretty bad happened.”
“Huh?”
“A well known businessman and his spouse, a politician, were killed by their own daughter.”
“It was huge international news.”
“What does that have to do with these photos?”
“The woman in the photo was involved.”
“Eh? Her?”
“Yeah. Apparently she was abused pretty bad, and that's why it happened.”
“She was sent to prison and only got out five years ago.”
“I mean, that sounds terrible, but why do you have pictures of her?”
“Because at the time her parents were both working with our boss.”
“It's a coincidence, I know. The company that this man worked for cooperated with us often.”
“He took his family on a business trip nearby, and I guess they went out sightseeing.”
“After learning who his wife was, my supervisors told me to investigate their personal life.”
“So I took these pictures. Don't they look so happy?”
“You could work as a paparazzi.”
“I told you I'm a professional.”
“I was supposed to write up a report, but I just didn't have the energy.”
“Very professional. But you're a good person, Shizuko.”
